title: A study to find out if BI 764198 helps adults and adolescents with a kidney condition called focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS)
official: A multicentre, randomised, double-blind, parallel group, placebo-controlled trial to assess the effects of oral TRPC6 inhibitor BI 764198 taken over a 104 week treatment period in adult and adolescent participants with primary focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (pFSGS) or genetic FSGS related to TRPC6 gene variants
summary: Main objective: The primary objective is to demonstrate superiority of BI 764198 for the mean relative change from baseline to Week 104 in 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio (UPCR, measured in mg/g) in participants with pFSGS or those with genetic FSGS due to TRPC6 gain-of-function gene mutations, some of whom are on background calcineurin inhibitor (CNI) treatment.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Male or female participants ≥12 years old on the day of signing informed consent/assent (Visit 1)
2. 2. Weight of ≥40 kg at the screening visit (Visit 1)
3. 3. Body Mass Index (BMI) of ≤40 kg/m2 at the screening visit (Visit 1)
4. 4. Participants with a diagnosis prior to the screening visit (Visit 1) of either: - biopsy-confirmed pFSGS (based on Investigator’s judgement) OR - genetic FSGS resulting from a gain-of-function gene mutation in the TRPC6 gene (based on historical genetic test)
5. 5. UPCR ≥1500 mg/g based on the mean of the spot urine sample and first morning void (FMV) urine sample (both assessed by central laboratory) at the screening visit (Visit 1)
6. 6. Estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR)   - For adult participants (≥18): ≥25 mL/min/1.73 m2 (CKD-EPI formula based on serum cystatin C) at the screening visit (Visit 1)  - For adolescent participants (12 to <18 years): ≥25 mL/min/1.73 m2 based on CKiD U25 formula using serum cystatin C at the screening visit (Visit 1)
7. Further inclusion criteria apply.
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Known monogenic or syndromic causes of FSGS (with the exception of TRPC6 gain-of-function gene mutations)
2. 2. Clinical or histologic evidence of secondary adaptive or toxic forms of FSGS (based on Investigator’s judgement)
3. 3. FSGS of undetermined cause (FSGS-UC) with a diagnosis prior to the screening visit (Visit 1) (based on Investigator’s judgement)
4. 4. A history of organ transplantation or planned organ transplantation during the course of the trial
5. 5. Use of intravenous immunosuppressive agents (e.g. cyclophosphamide, rituximab, obinutuzumab) in the last 6 months prior to screening (Visit 1)
6. Further exclusion criteria apply.
